name: Set Up Closet Shelf Paint Protection
intent: Floor runner at closet entry, wall masking adjacent to shelf spans (spray only), and fixture covers for rod/hanger supports (spray only) before closet shelf paint work. Rates cloned from door frame protection — closet shelves are LF surfaces with similar protection footprint.
doctrine: Brush_roll omits wall masking and fixture covers (applies_when gates). Spray and spray_rolloff include full masking. Rates cloned from MOD_SETUP_DOOR_FRAME_PAINT_PROTECT because protection workflow is identical — painter works around finished surfaces at the same pace.
